description: This file is a unit test class for the ElasticSearchEngine component of SuiteCRM, specifically testing search query validation, search parameter creation, execution of ElasticSearch queries, and parsing of search hits.

classes.name: ElasticSearchEngineTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending SearchTestAbstract that contains multiple test cases for ElasticSearchEngine functionality.

methods.name: testValidateQuery
methods.description: Tests the query validation method of ElasticSearchEngine to ensure it properly cleans or formats the search query string.

methods.name: testCreateSearchParams1
methods.description: Validates the creation of search parameters with a specific search string and query settings.

methods.name: testCreateSearchParams2
methods.description: Validates the creation of search parameters with a different search string and default settings.

methods.name: testRunElasticSearch
methods.description: Tests executing an ElasticSearch query using a mocked Client and verifies the results.

methods.name: testParseEmptyHits
methods.description: Tests parsing of an empty hits response from ElasticSearch, expecting an empty result array.
